name: Gisogd
description: Public portal of the state information system for urban planning (GIS OGD) of Tambov Oblast, part of the 2025 standard ('typovoe reshenie') GIS OGD roll-out. Vue SPA on the Bingo-Soft Accent low-code platform (appConfig ag_grid_license CompanyName=Bingo-Soft, LicensedApplication=Accent). Verified live 2026-09-30 (HTTP 200); officially referenced by the Tambov Oblast construction ministry (archit.tmbreg.ru/proekty/gisogd.html).
